description_en: Apparently erected in the 20th century, the exact origin of this Śiva temple remains enigmatic owing to the lack of historical records.Designated merely as aśivālaya(lit. the abode of Śiva) in this documentation due to uncertainty about its nomenclature, this brick temple is built on three plinth levels within the Gorakhanātha complex. Positioned north of the Narendreśvara Mandira (PPK1953), the temple's bell-shaped roof, adorned with a metallic finial, imparts it a distinctive appearance. Accessible through entrances on all four sides embellished with stone archways (toraṇa) featuring central carvings of Chepu, a mythical water creature, the eastern door serves as the principal entrance. Inside the sanctum, aśivaliṅgais enshrined as the temple's primary deity. A small Bhairava mask is embedded on the southern outer wall adjacent to the entrance. In addition to anotherśivaliṅgato the west of the temple, six additionalśivaliṅgas are positioned to its northwest. Surrounding the temple, one can also observe a figure of Śiva's animal mount Nandī, along with a statue of Akṣobhya, and an inscription dating back to 1613 CE (NS 733).The absence of inscriptions at the site veils the donor's identity and the year of the temple's construction in mystery. The inscription from 1613 CE (NS 733) situated northeast of the temple predates it by at least two centuries, likely belonging to another monument but established here at a later time. Despite the ambiguity surrounding its origins, the architectural features point to a construction date during the 20th century (G. Ṭaṇḍana VS 2053, p.351). The temple endured damages in the 2015 earthquakes and underwent restoration by the Pashupati Area Development Trust in 2021 CE (VS 2078).Daily worship rituals are performed here by somekanaphaṭṭājogīs, the ascetics with slit ears, affiliated with the Gorakhanātha temple.
description_ne: ईशाको बीसौं शताब्दीतिर निर्माण गरिएको यस शिवालयमा गोरखनाथ मन्दिरका कानफट्टा योगीहरूले नित्यपूजा गरिरहेका छन् ।पशुपति क्षेत्रमा रहेको गोरखनाथ परिसरमा नरेन्द्रेश्वर मन्दिर (PPK1953) को उत्तरमा यो शिवालय अवस्थित रहेको छ । तीन तहको इँटाको पेटीमाथि घण्टाकार शैलीमा यो शिवालय निर्माण गरिएको छ । इँटा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको यस शिवालयमा धातुको गजूर राखिएको छ । शिवालयका चारै दिशामा ढोकाहरू राखिएको भएपनि पूर्वाभिमुख ढोकालाई प्रवेशद्वारको रूपमा प्रयोग गरिएको छ । चारै ढोकामाथि ढुङ्गाका ढोका राखी ढोकामाथि छेपु अङ्कित ढुङ्गाकै तोरण राखिएका छन् । शिवालयको गर्भगृहभित्र शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ । शिवालयको दक्षिणपट्टिको भित्तामा भैरवको मुखाकृति स्थापना गरिएको छ । शिवालयको पश्चिममा एउटा शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ । शिवालयको उत्तर‍-पश्चिममा छवटा शिवलिङ्ग, नन्दी, अक्षोभ्य र नेसं ७३३ को एउटा शिलापत्र स्थापना गरिएका छन् ।यो शिवालयको स्थापनाबारे कुनै अभिलेख पाइएको छैन । शिवालयको उत्तर-पश्चिममा रहेको नेसं ७३३ को शिलापत्र शिवालय स्थापना हुनुभन्दा धेरै अगाडिको हो । शिवालयसँग उक्त शिलापत्रको कुनै सम्बन्ध छैन । यस शिवालयको नाम, स्थापना गर्ने दाता र स्थापना गरिएको मितिबारे थाहा पाइएको छैन । शैलीको आधारमा यो शिवालय ईशाको बीसौं शताब्दीतिर बनेको निर्माण गरिएको देखिन्छ (G. Ṭaṇḍana VS 2053, p.351) । विसं २०७२ (सन् २०१५) को भूकम्पले यस शिवालयमा केही क्षति पुगेकोले विसं २०७८ (सन् २०२१) मा पशुपति क्षेत्र विकास कोषद्वारा सामान्य मर्मत गरिएको थियो ।यो शिवालयमा गोरखनाथ मन्दिरका कानफट्टा योगीहरूले नित्यपूजा गरिरहेका छन् । उनीहरूलाई कुनै निकायबाट पारिश्रमिक पनि दिइएको छैन ।

historical_events.event_description: The inscription dating back to 1613 CE (NS 733), located to the northeast of the temple, is unrelated to the temple itself. It precedes the temple's construction by a minimum of two centuries, likely originating from another structure but later placed at this site. Due to significant erosion, the complete understanding of its content remains elusive. The inscription makes reference to the establishment of an oil-related trust, indicating that a benefactor likely erected a statue or temple and instituted a trust for the purpose of illuminating oil lamps at the site.
